statements.subject: session
statements.description: A UA requests the immediate removal of a binding by specifying an expiration interval of '0' for that contact address in a REGISTER request.
statements.trigger: REGISTER request with expiration interval 0 for contact address
actions: remove binding for specified contact address

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The REGISTER-specific Contact header field value of '*' MUST NOT be used unless the Expires header field is present with a value of '0'.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Use of the '*' Contact header field value allows a registering UA to remove all bindings associated with an address-of-record without knowing their precise values.
statements.trigger: REGISTER request with Contact=* and Expires=0
actions: remove all bindings associated with address-of-record
